def transform(grid):
    # Tile four rotated copies in a 2x2 arrangement: original, clockwise,
    # counterclockwise, then 180-degree rotation.
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    clockwise = [[grid[n - 1 - r][c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(m)]
    counterclockwise = [[grid[r][m - 1 - c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(m)]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)]
